note: Budgets checked by scripts/v4/verify-budgets.mjs. Sizes are gzip bytes and fail on more than size.tolerance growth. Runtime budgets are medians of repeated runs in Chromium at 4x CPU: observers and listeners created may not grow at all, observe() calls may not exceed budget x callTolerance, DOM mutation records budget x writeTolerance, and times max(budget x timeTolerance, budget + timeFloorMs); times are enforced only on the calibration machine (calibrated.runtime: platform and CPU model) and never on a GitHub-hosted runner (TYPESET_HOSTED_RUNNER=1), where they are recorded. Budgets start at the values measured when they were introduced (4.2.0's engine) and are lowered as the 4.3 performance work lands; raise one only with a recorded reason.
